title: Two Looks for One Demo: A Bright Video Language | vitalii.no
description:
Every demo video for this project used the same dark, terminal-style visual style — great for developers, opaque for anyone who doesn't already read code. There was no lighter way to show off a feature to a non-technical viewer, and every clip was a silent loop with no voice at all.

I built a second visual language for these demos: bright-theme.ts and bright-primitives.tsx, a light explainer template with problem and solution zones, a browser window mockup, real-data tables, filter chips, a toggle, a clicking cursor, icon cards, and before-and-after metric panels. One existing clip was rewritten from the old dark style into this new bright one, and alongside it I built the pipeline's first long-form narrated format — a full story cut with timing baked directly from the measured voice audio, so the picture always lands exactly on the words.

The result: two distinct visual languages for feature demos instead of one, plus a brand-new format. That first narrated walkthrough runs 54 seconds — the first fully voiced demo this project has ever shipped, instead of just another silent loop.
